recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-40757 unless the work group later revises the broader mixed-version conversion guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-40757 asked how R4 data can satisfy mandatory SampledData.period when using R5 backport extensions such as SampledData.offsets that make the older mandatory element obsolete. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution directed the spec to add versions.html guidance that data-absent-reason with value not-applicable can satisfy the minimum cardinality and that systems should check for actual values, not just element presence.
initial_application: Git history shows an initial source/versions.html insertion in 7e5f4f3cf5 and a corrected application in aec3a16f60. The corrected commit linked data-absent-reason properly and adjusted the wording to trial-use versions; that source text is present on the current combined branch.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records the original SampledData.offsets/R4 period question and the Data Absent Reason option. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-06-12 record the 11-0-0 Persuasive with Mod decision that data-absent-reason/not-applicable can indicate SampledData.period is not used and satisfies the R4 mandatory requirement, with general mixed-version guidance to be added.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/versions.html is the active Version Management Policy page and already contains the accepted paragraph in the Managing Change during the development process section, including data-absent-reason not-applicable and the SHOULD-level warning to check for a value.
